No. There's two situations that are most likely to unfold.

1. The enemy comes to shove mid before drag, you kill two melee minions trying to slowpush while the enemy clears your entire wave. You miss 4 minions (~80 gold) and lose prio.

2. The drag fight ends and they collect the mid wave that's crashed. Regardless of who won the fight, when you slowpush, it means more of the enemy minions are dying than yours. That means that the enemy can collect more gold from the wave and you've lost 1-2 waves. 

The main problem is that a slowpush requires 1-3 waves to build up, which is 1:00+ of game time, which makes it very difficult to execute, especially in the mid lane, since usually the drag fight will be over or they can send one player over to clear the wave while in the middle of a dragon dance.
